σίλλῠβος , ὁ,
A.parchment-label, appended to the outside of a book, Cic. Att. 4.4a . 1 , 4.8.2 , dub. in 4.5.3 (v. infr.): pl. σίλλυβα , τά,= θύσανοι, Poll. 7.64 . (In Cic. Att. 4.5.3 the vv.ll. sit tybis and sic tu iubes are perh. traces of sittybis; but σιττύβαι (q.v.) has an inappropriate meaning, unless it can mean leather case of a book.)
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
